DECL	{"assumptions":[],"binders":["v"],"id":"NRS_484B_250_4_o2","intentions":[],"laws":["NRS-484B-250-4"],"narrowings":[{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"'which have previously completed a stop' is read as a standstill of that road user, on a carrier whose entrance end is this junction, at some observation of the recording up to and including the judged one: the language looks back to an observation at or before the one it judges, and a road user standing at an entrance at the judged observation has come to the halt the words describe."},{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"the clearance of p.yield_min_clearance is read on two measurements the record names together: the centre distance at the closest approach under constant velocities within p.yield_conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_distance), and the clearance between the nearest points of the two bodies at the observation (rel.surface_gap); precedence is denied where either falls below it while the centres approach within the horizon."},{"kind":"reading","span":"st1","why":"the duty is read at every observation from the qualified entry at which the subject's footprint still overlaps the junction region, that unbroken occupancy carrying 'from that entry on, while the subject is moving across or within the intersection'; it is not read after the subject's footprint has left the junction."}],"operationalizations":[{"concepts":["drv.motion.region_entry","kin.speed","prim.closest_approach_distance","prim.closest_approach_within","rel.occupies","st.intersection"],"params":["p.cautious_proceed_max_speed","p.yield_conflict_horizon","p.yield_min_clearance"],"standard":"shall proceed cautiously","surrogate":false}],"residues":[],"surrogate":false}
